rounds.text: TCM Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its sector peers, with a price-to-book ratio of 1.27x compared to the sector benchmark of 1.83x [E6]. This valuation gap is particularly compelling given the company’s demonstrated ability to scale, evidenced by compounded sales growth of 36% over five years and 39% over three years [E13, E14]. The business is clearly in an active expansion phase, as shown by a 150% increase in capital work in progress [E36]. Furthermore, recent performance metrics highlight strong momentum, with year-over-year sales growth of 52% and profit growth exceeding 20% [E55, E58]. This top-line expansion significantly outpaces the sector median sales growth of 17.9% [E65]. Conceded: the company currently faces profitability challenges with a negative ROA of -6.35% and ROE of -23.53% [E7, E8], alongside a recent 11% contraction in trailing twelve-month sales [E15].
